name: skiphow
description: Handle product and software work from one ordinary-language request.

interface.longDescription: Understand the request, make routine technical decisions, do the work the user authorized, and verify the result. Use tracking and long-running coordination only when the task needs them.
defaultPrompt: Add this feature and make the routine product and technical decisions.
Fix this bug, prove the cause when needed, and verify the result.
Save this product idea for later without expanding it.
